html:
{%- set agent_name = frappe.db.get_value("Mobile Trip", doc.mobile_trip, "agent_name") if doc.mobile_trip else "" -%}
{{ doc.company }}
{{ _("PAYMENT RECEIPT") }}
{%- if agent_name %}{% endif %}
{{ _("Receipt") }}{{ doc.name }}
{{ _("Date") }}{{ frappe.format(doc.posting_date, "Date") }}
{{ _("Customer") }}{{ doc.party_name or doc.party }}
{{ _("Mode") }}{{ doc.mode_of_payment or "" }}
{{ _("Agent") }}{{ agent_name }}
{%- for ref in doc.references %} {%- endfor %} {%- if doc.unallocated_amount %}{% endif %}
{{ _("Invoice") }}{{ _("Settled") }}
{{ ref.reference_name }}{{ ref.get_formatted("allocated_amount", doc) }}
{{ _("On account") }}{{ doc.get_formatted("unallocated_amount") }}
{{ _("Amount Received") }}{{ doc.get_formatted("paid_amount") }}
{{ _("Thank you") }}
name: Mobile Collection Receipt
